dimensions.assessment: Affects the local population of the longfin smelt fish species in the San Francisco Bay-Delta region, as well as regional regulatory and commercial stakeholders.
dimensions.evidence: Endangered Species Status for the San Francisco Bay-Delta Distinct Population Segment of the Longfin Smelt

dimensions.assessment: Completely removes Endangered Species Act protections for the species by rendering the listing rule of no force or effect.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect

Exercises congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, to nullify a federal agency rule.

importance_detail.rationale: Nullifies a U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service rule listing the San Francisco Bay-Delta distinct population segment of the longfin smelt as endangered, removing its protections under the Endangered Species Act.
